arc.energy_shape_notes: One slow swell with four dropouts, peak at the very end. RMS rises -17.6 (0:00-0:30) -> -12.4 (2:00-2:30 first peak) -> valley -15.0 (3:00-3:30) -> rebuild -> loudest window -8.9dB at 5:15 (94% of runtime), then a dark step back to -12.2dB. No climax in the middle, no comedown after the peak. Dropouts at 2:20 (-16.3), 2:55 (-17.0), 3:35 (-17.0), 5:00 (-16.6) reset the climb each time.

progression_alt_static_tonic: {root} min for the full runtime; iv (Bb min) colour only at ~0:30 and ~1:30

harmony.home_scale: F natural minor (F G Ab Bb C Db Eb); tonic never leaves - no modulation in 5:33
signature_devices: Static tonic: F minor for the full runtime; only harmonic colour is the iv chord (Bb minor) surfacing at 0:30 and 1:30 (key detector reads these as A# min - check chroma before believing a modulation).
No leading tone, no V-i, no functional motion - tension from dynamics alone, not harmony.
F root is the most consistent chroma presence in the track (pitch class 5 leads nearly every 10s window, 0.46-0.87, peaking 0.87 in the final window).
Steady 136 BPM grid; per-minute reads 143.6 for the first two minutes then 136.0, downbeat spacing (~1.72-1.76s) supports ~136-140 throughout - no accelerando, no half-time, no grid dropout.
beat_times_s are downbeats (~34.9/min), not beats - same correction as ARTIFICIAL INSTRUMENTS.
Dropout swell: the level is pulled out 3-5 times (-16 to -17dB) inside one slow rise; the grid holds while the signal cuts out.
No onset analysis was run - drum pattern is an assumption from album context, not a measurement (see report Honest Limits).

tempo.feel: Steady 136 BPM, no tempo event. Slow and patient; the steadiness is the point, set against the level constantly cutting out.

timbre.palette_notes: Dark at the edges, bright in the middle. Centroid mean 2812Hz (range 900-3651Hz), rolloff mean 5807Hz, ZCR mean 0.10 (max 0.18) - low noise content, no digital-shrapnel layer. Opens at 900Hz centroid / 1296Hz rolloff (near-sine low wash) and closes at 1283Hz. Loud sections darken (centroid ~2100Hz at the 2:00 peak, ~1500Hz at the finale, ZCR 0.028); quiet valley brightens (up to 3651Hz at 2:55). Master never touches 0dBFS (peak max -1.1dBFS) - quieter master than LYRICAL DOOM.
